label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: The cookie dialog offered only [name] Settings, Preferences and Accept, with no decline button. Escape sent focus to a Close modal button which removed the overlay, but it was never clear whether cookies were accepted or declined.
After closing the overlay, focus dropped to nothing at the top of the page and the first Tab press did nothing visible, so I could not tell where I was.

The Skip to content link only reached the main region. I then needed about ten more Tab presses through the breadcrumb, FILTER button, seven category links and the Sort button before the first product.

Quick Add put a $649.95 set in the cart at once, with no choice of colour. The cart drawer opened and focus landed on a generic div, and the cart then showed 2 items from a free gift I had not chosen.

In the cart drawer, reaching CONTINUE TO CHECKOUT took about 16 Tab presses through Close, unnamed links, Remove, Edit, quantity, What is Included and upsell colour and ADD buttons. Two links had no accessible name, and the Remove and Increase quantity buttons sat right on the route, so one slip would change the cart.
